ideas.pitch: An automated multi-agent workflow that helps beginner-to-intermediate CTF players rapidly triage digital forensics artifacts and OSINT leads.
ideas.problem_statement: InIt CTF features Jeopardy-style challenges across categories like Digital Forensics, OSINT, and Web Exploitation, requiring fast investigation under an 8-hour continuous time limit.
ideas.title: CTF-Helper Bot: AI-Driven Multi-Agent Pipeline for OSINT and Forensics
ideas.why_it_could_win: By leveraging a multi-agent pipeline inspired by winning automation architectures, it targets the high-stress, rapid-triage nature of an 8-hour CTF sprint.

ideas.pitch: A security auditing tool designed specifically to practice, simulate, and understand common Web Exploitation vectors mapped to CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: InIt CTF includes Web Exploitation challenges ranging from easy to hard difficulty, testing participants on finding vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: PayloadPulse: Automated Web Exploitation Defenses & Exploit Simulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep cybersecurity domain knowledge and fulfills the defense-in-depth principles proven in security-focused hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web dashboard for beginners that visualizes cryptographic attacks like RSA factoring, XOR cipher analysis, and frequency distributions.
ideas.problem_statement: InIt CTF includes Cryptography challenges meant to test both beginners and experienced players on solving mathematical and cipher-based puzzles.
ideas.title: CryptoCracker Kit: Visual Cryptanalysis and Lattice Reduction Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the steep learning curve for beginners in CTF cryptography by providing clear visual feedback and rapid solving scripts.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined tool for extracting hidden metadata, analyzing memory dumps, and uncovering steganography in CTF forensic challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: InIt CTF features Digital Forensics challenges where participants must extract flags from corrupted files, packet captures, and disk images.
ideas.title: StegnoScope: Automated Digital Forensics Artifact Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Saves critical minutes during an 8-hour continuous CTF by automating tedious forensic file-carving tasks.

ideas.pitch: A real-time shared workspace for CTF teams to sync flag submissions, drop challenge hints, and automatically compile Markdown write-ups.
ideas.problem_statement: InIt CTF allows teams of 1 to 4 members to collaborate across various technical and non-technical backgrounds during an intense 8-hour window.
ideas.title: FlagVault: Team Collaboration and Write-up Generator for CTFs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the logistical overhead of team coordination during a tight, time-constrained competition format.
